simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עֲבֻדָּה (H5657) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עֲבֻדָּה (ʻăbuddâh) means something wrought , i.e. (concretely) service First listed occurrence: Gen 26 14.

definitions.full: H5657. abuddah עֲבֻדָּה noun feminine service (on formation see Lag BN 151 ); — of household servants as a body, || cattle, etc., Gen 26:14 (J) Job 1:3 .
